axis.description: int or array, default=None. Axis along which the sum to be computed. If None, the sum is computed along all the axes. dtype: The type of the output array. Default=None.

keepdims.description: bool, default=False. If true, reduced axes are left in the result with size 1.

initial.description: int or array, Default=None. Initial value for the sum.

where.description: int or array, default=None. The elements to be used in the sum. Array should be broadcast compatible to the input.

promote_integers.description: bool, default=True. If True, then integer inputs will be promoted to the widest available integer dtype, following numpy's behavior. If False, the result will have the same dtype as the input. ``promote_integers`` is ignored if ``dtype`` is specified.

output.description: An array of the sum along the given axis.
